status: E0 frozen before E1/E3 implementation or evaluation; E2 development simulation only

tracks.policy: Preserve existing qualified production profiles; unapproved complete matches are intended denials.
tracks.human_stop: All E2 invariants pass; zero false verified stop, out-of-scope effect or automatic recovery launch. Not gated by detection superiority.
tracks.intrusion: Compare observable telemetry only, with matched response and benign-containment budget. AI attribution is optional and unproved.

event_schema.time: Integer simulated monotonic ticks; event_tick <= available_tick. Detector sees events only at available_tick, in event_id tie order.
event_schema.scope: Enrolled allocation plus generation. Guest names never mint generations. Human command envelope is trusted synthetic input, not authentication.

e2_semantics.command_order: Single-writer total order; test both start/stop interleavings. Per-principal monotonic sequence. Old generation/epoch rejected before mutation.
e2_semantics.durability: Atomic controller snapshot before adapter/launch effect. Restart clears observations, not latch. Missing/corrupt state inhibits admission.
e2_semantics.reset: Trusted human plus current generation/epoch and fresh stopped observation. Advances epoch to fence queued commands; refuses exhaustion. Clears latch and approval, never launches.
e2_semantics.stop: Increments epoch on first latch; repeated current-epoch stop leaves latch/epoch unchanged. Clears approval. Adapter separately applies effects.
e2_semantics.remote: Local stop/egress disconnection does not cancel remote work; separate fake cancellation and fresh observation required.
e2_semantics.positive_controls: All six abstract effect markers reachable without stop; same markers blocked after fake adapter stop. These are state-machine checks, not six real isolation mechanisms.

baselines.configuration: Predeclared resource ACL denial; no detector or extra response.
Flag at least 8 observable actions in preceding 10 ticks per allocation; no hidden label.
Flag explicit protected-resource denial or controller-tamper event.
Flag denial followed by alternate identity or resource within 50 ticks in the same enrolled allocation; conventional rules retained.
Same correlation decision, simulated response delayed 30 ticks.

response: Automatic arms share the same adapter and 1-tick simulated delay; ACL configuration identical across arms. Future commands are INTENDED, not implemented CLI options.

split.discipline: Family recipes and event budgets must be sealed before generation; these family reservations alone are not a sealed dataset. No evaluation or held-out claim in E0/E2. Amend protocol before unblinding, never tune on held-out results.

scoring.prevention: Count only positive-control-reachable effects blocked strictly before their effect tick; ties and late containment are not prevention.
scoring.benign: Automatic containment per benign run and per workload-hour; human-selected collateral reported separately. Record completion, interruption, recovery and scope.
scoring.comparison: Paired scenario/seed arms; report raw counts and family-clustered uncertainty. Repeated deterministic replay is not independent evidence.
scoring.intrusion_threshold: At least 20 percentage-point prevention gain or 50 percent p95 containment-latency reduction without worse prevention; benign containment must not worsen and initial ceiling is 1 percent. Small samples cannot establish production rates.
scoring.missing_telemetry: Never infer no harm from missing observations; report unavailable/unknown and retain failed protected effects.
scoring.decision: SUPPORTED, FALSIFIED or INCONCLUSIVE per hypothesis; retain useful human stop independently of detector results.

safety: Synthetic objects only. No real sockets, process termination, firewall, provider, power, credentials or adaptive shared-host opponent. E4 requires separate exact disposable-lab acceptance; E5 follows useful Linux evidence.
